mechanism: Magnesium acts as a natural calcium antagonist and can inhibit Na-K-ATPase pump activity, potentially increasing digoxin levels and enhancing its cardioactive effects while also competitively reducing digoxin absorption.
action: Monitor serum digoxin levels closely; maintain adequate magnesium levels (hypomagnesemia increases digoxin toxicity risk); space administration timing if possible and assess for signs of digoxin toxicity including arrhythmias.
